title: Requires school districts to comply with statewide summative assessment participation requirements and to demonstrate improved student achievement on statewide summative assessments to be eligible for state funding related to the High School Graduation and College and Career Readiness Act.

claims.text: HB 3055 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
